copy:
Savor a festive and scrumptious lunch at Plaza Inn with an all-in-one meal package that comes with reserved viewing for A Christmas Fantasy Parade—featuring some favorite Disney Characters spreading holiday cheer! 

Dining Dates and Showtimes 

  • November 13 through December 30, 2026
  • All Guests will receive a voucher for the day’s second performance of A Christmas Fantasy Parade.

Package Pricing: Lunch

  • $61 per adult
  • $34 per child (ages 3 to 9)

Tax is not included. Gratuity is not included or required.

Adult Dining Package Menu

  • Choice of one entrée: chicken, meatloaf, pasta penne or salmon
  • Side salad
  • Holiday dessert
  • Choice of one beverage: fountain beverage or Dasani water

Child Dining Package Menu

  • Choice of one entrée: Chicken tenders or pasta marinara
  • Carrots
  • Apple sauce
  • Holiday dessert
  • Choice of one beverage: Dasani water or low-fat milk

Plant-based options are available for both the adult and child menu.

Blockout Dates – 2026

  • This dining package will not be available on the following dates:

    • November 25, 26, 29, 30

    • December 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 24, 25

items.title: Park Admission and Park Reservation Required
items.content:
Valid Disneyland Park admission (not included in the price of these packages) and Disneyland Park reservations for the same day are required for entry. Park reservations are limited, subject to availability and not guaranteed.


A reservation for this dining package does not guarantee Disneyland Park admission or a park reservation.

items.title: Reservations
items.content:
Advance reservations are highly recommended and can be made on this page or with the Disneyland app. Same-day reservations can be made at the restaurant but are limited and subject to availability.


A credit card guarantee is required at time of booking.

items.title: Checking In
items.content: Check in at the Plaza Inn restaurant entrance up to 10 minutes prior to your scheduled reservation. Payment for dining packages is required upon check-in.

items.title: Vouchers and Credentials
items.content: One credential for the meal and one voucher for the reserved viewing area for A Christmas Fantasy Parade will be issued for each dining package purchased. Each person in the party must purchase a dining package to obtain a credential and voucher. Vouchers are valid only for the designated showtime on the same day as the dining experience. Packages and vouchers may not be refunded, redeemed for cash, sold or exchanged for different dates or times. A host will issue all vouchers when you pay for your meal.

items.title: Viewing Areas
items.content:
Your viewing-area voucher lists the viewing location, arrival reservation time and show performance time. Please arrive no more than 10 minutes before your reservation time.

The viewing area is separate from the dining location and mainly offers standing room or ground seating. If 2 shows are scheduled, the viewing area will be available for the second show of the day. Please ask a Cast Member if you need directions.

Both a credential and voucher are required to enter the viewing area.

Due to overwhelming demand, special seating requests or preferences cannot be accommodated except for wheelchair accessibility.

Early and late arrivals cannot be accommodated.

items.title: Showtimes and Cancellations
items.content:
Check the Disneyland app or the entertainment calendar for the performance schedule.

Performances can be cancelled without notice due to technical, weather or other issues. No refunds or exchanges will be available, even if the show is cancelled.

items.title: Children
items.content: Children must be accompanied by an adult 18 years of age or older for the duration of the dining and viewing experiences.

items.title: Character Dining Not Offered During Dining Packages
items.content: Character Dining is not offered at Plaza Inn during lunch, dinner or Dining Packages at Plaza Inn.

items.title: Subject to Change
items.content: Menu items, pricing and hours are subject to change without notice. Entertainment, experiences and offerings may be modified, limited in availability or unavailable, and are subject to restrictions, change or cancellation without notice. Park admission and offerings are not guaranteed.

items.title: Cancellation Policy
items.content:
This restaurant has a cancellation policy. The credit card provided at the time of reservation will automatically be charged a per-person fee if you don’t show up for your reservation or fail to cancel in accordance with the policy. Policy details will be available when you make your reservation and in your confirmation email.

Cancellations and modifications to reservations can be made by visiting My Dining and Activity Reservations or via the Disneyland app by tapping "My Plans."

importantMessage.title: An Important Message
importantMessage.content: In-park dining requires a theme park reservation and valid admission for the same park on the same date for each person ages 3 and older. Dining reservations do not guarantee admission to the parks.
